description: Address 6 post-review issues: wallet race conditions, view/comment count stale reads, pervasive 'as any' casts, conversation unread JSONB overwrite, signupChecks non-atomic increment, and ResetPassword session timing.
steps: Fix wallet race condition: use conditional update with .gte('total', amount) to prevent negative balance in useTipSend.ts, LiveViewer.tsx, and FinanceDepartment.tsx
Fix view/comment count: add comments documenting the known limitation (stale-read increment) in PostCard.tsx and CommentSheet.tsx
Remove 'as any' casts from all .from() calls where tables are defined in the Database type
Fix Conversation markRead to use proper JSONB merge pattern instead of overwriting
Add comment to signupChecks.ts documenting the non-atomic increment limitation
Fix ResetPassword to guard submit behind session check via onAuthStateChange
acceptance_criteria: Wallet updates use conditional .gte() to prevent negative balances
'as any' casts removed from .from() calls for tables in Database type
Conversation markRead uses JSONB merge approach (separate unread_counts table)
ResetPassword form is disabled until session is confirmed via onAuthStateChange
Known limitations documented with TODO comments
verification: Run 'bunx tsc --noEmit' and confirm no new type errors
Run 'bun run build' and confirm build succeeds
